name: rotavix
description: RotaVIX — Aplicativo de transporte rodoviário (Angular + NestJS + Docker)

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.build:web: cd web/rotavix-web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm rebuild && pnpm exec ng build --configuration production
scripts.build:api: cd api/rotavix-api && npm install --cache /tmp/npm-cache && npm run build
